reference_sql:
WITH sales_side AS (
  -- one row per channel: revenue in sales for April 2025 (order_date is the UTC day)
  SELECT channel, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS sales_revenue
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-01' AND DATE '2025-04-30'
  GROUP BY channel
), lines_side AS (
  -- one row per channel: the same revenue from the lines of the orders placed in April 2025 (UTC)
  SELECT o.channel, SUM(l.quantity * l.unit_price_eur - l.line_discount_eur) AS lines_revenue
  FROM order_lines l
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00'
    AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-05-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY o.channel
)
SELECT s.channel, s.sales_revenue, l.lines_revenue, s.sales_revenue - l.lines_revenue AS difference
FROM sales_side s
JOIN lines_side l ON l.channel = s.channel
alternatives:
WITH both_sides AS (
  -- one row per sales line or raw line of April 2025 (UTC), with its channel, its revenue and its side
  SELECT channel, net_revenue_eur AS revenue, 'sales' AS side
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-01' AND DATE '2025-04-30'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT o.channel, l.quantity * l.unit_price_eur - l.line_discount_eur, 'lines'
  FROM order_lines l
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00'
    AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-05-01 00:00:00'
)
SELECT channel,
  SUM(revenue) FILTER (WHERE side = 'sales') AS sales_revenue,
  SUM(revenue) FILTER (WHERE side = 'lines') AS lines_revenue,
  SUM(revenue) FILTER (WHERE side = 'sales') - SUM(revenue) FILTER (WHERE side = 'lines') AS difference
FROM both_sides
GROUP BY channel

solver.query:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT channel, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS r FROM sales
  WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-04-01' AND order_date < DATE '2025-05-01'
  GROUP BY channel
), l AS (
  SELECT o.channel, SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur) AS r
  FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-05-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY o.channel
)
SELECT COALESCE(s.channel, l.channel) AS channel, s.r AS sales_revenue, l.r AS lines_revenue,
  COALESCE(s.r, 0) - COALESCE(l.r, 0) AS difference
FROM s FULL JOIN l ON l.channel = s.channel
